Abstract.AbstractText: Eight new natural products (four new cucurbitane aglycones, hemslepencins A-D (1-4), four new cucurbitane glucosides, hemslepensides F-I (5-8), along with seven known compounds (9-15), were isolated from the roots of Hemsleya pengxianensis. The structures of 1-8 were elucidated using IR, HRESIMS, and NMR. Compound 3 exhibited cytotoxic activity against the human cancer cell lines.
